questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct ****alternative out of the four and ****indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.** 

His teacher _____ an explanation of his conduct.
questions.solution:
The teacher is asking him for an explanation for his conduct. Therefore, we will use **call for, **which means 'to ask'.

Hence, option 2 ie. *Called for *is the correct answer.

__**Note**__:

 
• To** call off **means** to cancel.**
 
• To call up means to call someone on the phone.

questions.question:

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is** Bring to an end.**

• For Example - We have to decide, **once and for all**, whether we want to ask Dad for money.
 
 
 
• Hence, **Option 1) Bring to an end **is the correct answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution: The past tense of *quit *is **quit **only. *He *is accompanied by **has**. Hence, Option 1) *He has quit *is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase.** 

As opposed to reality imagined not real.
questions.solution:
Ennui = boredom.

Heretic = having a belief or opinion contrary to orthodox religious (especially Christian) doctrine.

Fictitious = made up; not real.

Indict = formally accuse of a charge or crime.

Hence, Option 3) *Fictitious *is the correct answer.

**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.** 

It takes 

<div class="OutlineElement Ltr SCXW206077828&q
questions.solution:
The only thing that can be taken out of the three starting words of P, Q, and R is **time** => R is first in sequence. Rule out 2) and 4). A sentence can't end with *their *=> P can't be last => rule out 1). Hence, Option 3) *RPQ *is the correct answer.

*It takes time for people to change their way of thinking. *

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.** 

Politeness is 

P: possessed by only 

Q: one nation or race 

R: not a quality
questions.solution:
*Politeness *and *quality *are terms that have to be immediately connected => R is first. Hence, Option 1) *RPQ *is the correct answer.

*Politeness is not a quality possessed by only one nation or race.*
